args.content:
## Hawaii Packing List

### Clothing
- Lightweight swimwear
- Quick-dry shorts and t-shirts
- Light jacket or sweater for cool evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals for beach
- Hiking boots (for volcano hikes)

### Toiletries
- Sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- Beach towel
- Reusable water bottle
- Toiletries: toothbrush, toothpaste, shampoo, conditioner, etc.

### Electronics
- Smartphone and charger
- Travel adapter (Type A/B)
- Portable power bank

### Miscellaneous
- Travel documents and passport
- Money and credit cards
- Travel insurance documents
- Camera and extra batteries
- Snorkeling gear (if renting)
- Beach umbrella/umbrella
- Beach bag or backpack
- Comfortable beach chair or lounger
- Sun hat or wide-brimmed hat
- Sunglasses

### Other
- Travel journal or notebook
- Snacks and energy bars
- First-aid kit
- Emergency contact list
- Snorkel mask and fins (if renting)
- Towel and beach blanket
- Travel-sized laundry detergent
- Quick-dry clothing for evenings
